environment.runtime: game Mono, x86_64 on Apple Silicon
environment.scenario: Single-player overworld, three heroes in Oarton, fixed town-hex camera, distance70, tilt50, rotation180, FOV23
environment.isolation: Disposable test copy and test save; no content packages
environment.hostLoad: Uncontrolled competing VM, WindowServer, another game and compiler processes observed; no unrelated processes stopped

method.primaryComparison: Same-process crossover with water patches fully removed/restored. Separately record fallback-disabled crossover and whole-framework DLL comparisons.
method.percentiles: Sorted frame times indexed floor((n-1)*p); FPS is1000/mean frame ms. Group summaries are medians of trial statistics.
method.foregroundRule: Use only trials fully focused with no focus transitions; retain all excluded trials.
method.dllComparisonCaveat: Separate-process comparisons were strongly confounded by changing host load. Report every anchored trial, do not attribute the entire DLL gap to this optimization.

numericalValidation.semantics: Read-only postfix on actual production callbacks; compares final vertices to native Perlin at updated cursor, and final normal arrays to original corner arithmetic. Prototype transpiler is disabled. Validation postfix removed before this result is written.

gameFree.frameworkBuild: Release passed, seven existing CS0649 warnings

limitations: No co-op, combat playthrough, Windows/Linux or long-session validation.
Normal reuse changes floating-point rounding; tested error is not a universal bound.
p99 and counts above33ms did not consistently improve; broad hitch elimination is not established.
Inactive diagnostics were present in both arms; no diagnostics-free overhead comparison.
Restart comparisons have host-load confounding; use crossover as narrower attribution evidence.
exploratoryReason: Pre-anchor trials have different camera targets or setup/focus changes; none contribute to acceptance metrics.
unpatchedWaterCrossoverMethod: Same process and candidate framework, with ONLY the two water transpilers fully removed/restored. Other framework optimizations remain enabled in both arms. No fallback-call overhead in the off arm. This isolates the water change; it is not a whole-master-DLL comparison.

state.semantics: Read-only reflection of production lifecycle/cache state and Harmony patch owners. production-on/off separately invokes Initialize/Shutdown for a within-process crossover diagnostic. Compiled patches remain installed and disabled helper calls still incur overhead; this is not a master-baseline comparison. production-unpatch/repatch instead removes/restores only the production water transpiler on both callbacks after rejecting other owners; unpatched callbacks contain no optimization helper calls. Other framework patches and restart-only configuration are unchanged.
